# Released-client compliance failures that are intended changes,
# one test id per line (file::test). Classified in
# docs/design/H108_compat.md (H108). The compliance-released job
# fails on any failure not listed here.

# anonymous account has no display name; since SP106 a created

# fixtures that model a nameless account fail. Comes out with
# the next client release, whose fixtures clear the name
# through the console.
